components.name: Button

components.name: Switch

components.name: Table

components.description: Segmented navigational control organizing content into selectable pane views.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal overlay dialog interrupting the workflow to present urgent decisions or confirmations.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Floating contextual label presenting descriptive hint text on focus or hover.
